description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally III Creature Subtype(s) Albino Snake (Reptilian) Corrosive Spider — Giant Crab (Aquatic) Gigantoad — Lenergia (Avian) Poison Bat (Avian) Shark (Aquatic) Warg Wolf — Wasp — This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 3rd-level list with a CR rating of 2 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 2nd-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list .
